name: Rebis Teosebia
original_name: レビス・テオセベイア
source:
A first-year student in the Pillar. She is marked with the sign of the Capricorn.

While she looks like a run-of-the-mill human, Rebis is in fact an inheritor of humanity's great traditions of magic and alchemy -- a homunculus.

A kind girl at heart, she nevertheless finds herself acting arrogantly. This is a bluff born from her fear of humans.

Despite these fears, Nanna has won her absolute trust. Rebis is currently researching romantic love at her suggestion.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/1991038758687482224/]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
